finalText:
**Redis died, and the app fell over behind it.** No restart of Redis in the log.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` [app.log:182](logs/app.log:182) |
| 02:14–02:31 | 173 `TimeoutError` after 5000ms, cache falls back to direct store reads |
| 02:29:12 | queue depth passes the 500 cap [app.log:647](logs/app.log:647) |
| 02:31:44 | `JavaScript heap out of memory` kills `worker-2` [app.log:717](logs/app.log:717) |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

All 13 `redis reconnect attempt` tries failed. Backoff stretched to 80s, so 17 minutes bought nothing.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused. Then cap the fallback path so a cold cache cannot fill the queue.
